types.description: Provisional generic 2-pole fuse; no selected hardware, ratings or protection suitability.

connectionCoverage.notes: Reviewed generic interface: 2 input/output pole pair(s), numbered by the existing core line/load convention. Two-terminal fuse elements are modeled as other functions, without a contact normal state; no common trip or switching mechanism is inferred. Optional: pole use by application; require both ends of every used pole in project review. No universal required points. Unmodeled: neutral, bonding, indicators and auxiliary interfaces. Author must select hardware and add voltage/AC/DC, current, fuse class, interrupting capacity and coordination data as applicable. No manufacturer pinout is asserted. L/T denote line and load side only, not phase or polarity.
